scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening theme music and credits roll over backstage imagery for Episode 19.

scenes.title: Proposing to Recall the Chief Producer
scenes.summary: When Xingtian's chairwoman commends the editorial office for clearing the false-ad crisis, Bu Xiaogu urges her to propose recalling Chun Yuqiao to the board and celebrates with Kaiwen.

scenes.title: Shock Arrival of a New Chief Producer
scenes.summary: Dressed up in sparkling pink expecting to welcome Chun Yuqiao back, Xingzi and Kaiwen are blindsided when longtime rival Xie Ling walks in announcing himself as Xingtian's new chief producer.

scenes.title: An Objective Verdict on Rival Xie Ling
scenes.summary: Consulted privately by Xingtian's chairwoman after Xie Ling volunteers to leave ME, Chun Yuqiao sets personal history aside and objectively confirms Xie Ling has the skill and resources to keep Xingtian ahead.

scenes.title: Xie Ling Takes Over Unit One
scenes.summary: As Unit One staff protest Xie Ling's sudden appointment, Bu Xiaogu realizes their crisis victory unintentionally proved Xingtian could run without Chun Yuqiao, while Xie Ling tells Chun Yuqiao's loyalists to pack up.
scenes.location: Xingtian open office and Chief Editor's Office

scenes.title: Recounting Xie Ling's Old Tricks
scenes.summary: Fuming in the open workspace, Xingzi and Kaiwen tell Bu Xiaogu how Xie Ling schemed against Chun Yuqiao at ME, exploited his breakup with Luo Lin, poached Yin Zhengyu, and now wants to harvest what Chun Yuqiao built.

scenes.title: Xie Ling Complains to the Chairwoman
scenes.summary: Calling Xingtian's chairwoman on his first morning to complain about Chun Yuqiao's former subordinates criticizing him aloud, Xie Ling is coolly told Xingtian values open speech and he must handle matters himself.

scenes.title: Headhunter Calls and London Ling's Reputation
scenes.summary: As headhunters flood Kaiwen and Xingzi with triple-salary offers and call Bu Xiaogu too, the partners explain why overseas-format specialist Xie Ling earned his nickname alongside Wang Er.

scenes.title: Xie Ling Tries to Win Over Bu Xiaogu
scenes.summary: Entering the chief editor's office alone to ask about the delayed travel show, Bu Xiaogu hears Xie Ling brush the show aside while praising her savvy and offering her a post on his new team.

scenes.title: The Iron Trio Chooses to Stay and Fight
scenes.summary: Warning that Xie Ling plans to flood Xingtian with British format remakes that would bury their original travel show forever, Bu Xiaogu convinces Kaiwen and Xingzi to pass up lucrative job offers and stay.

scenes.title: Camping Outside Human Resources Before the Annual Summit
scenes.summary: Refusing to serve Xie Ling, Kaiwen, Xingzi, and Bu Xiaogu haul their supplies outside the human resources director's office just as notice arrives for Xingtian's fiery annual executive strategy summit.

scenes.title: Clashing Over Freezing Original Shows
scenes.summary: At Xingtian's annual strategy summit, after a gag rule fines anyone mentioning the former administration a month's pay, Xie Ling proposes freezing all three domestic original shows and clashes sharply with Bu Xiaogu.

scenes.title: Wang Er and Talent Management Push Back
scenes.summary: Second Unit head Wang Er asks where Wen Simo's hit commentary show fits under Xie Ling's imported-format policy, and Xingtian's talent agency vice president objects to crowding out Xingtian's own artists with foreign stars.

scenes.title: Forfeiting a Month's Pay to Defend Originals
scenes.summary: After Xie Ling blurts out Chun Yuqiao's name first and loses a month's pay, Bu Xiaogu gladly forfeits her own month's salary to present data on how their travel show ignited original television, persuading the chairwoman not to freeze originals.

scenes.title: Brooding Over Second Place and New Business Cards
scenes.summary: Back in his office, Xie Ling fumes that the chairwoman's ban on second-place formats was a veiled jab comparing him to Chun Yuqiao, wonders where Bu Xiaogu truly stands, and receives his new Xingtian business cards.

scenes.title: Business Card Title Sparks an Office Clash
scenes.summary: Discovering Xingtian abolished the Chief Content Officer post after Chun Yuqiao left and appointed him merely over Unit One, an outraged Xie Ling demands to know what he lacks—and Xingzi and Kaiwen tell him bluntly.

scenes.title: Stella Warns Xie Ling on PR Discipline
scenes.summary: Stepping in to break up the confrontation, PR chief Stella introduces herself to Xie Ling and warns him that claiming to be company president outside violates Xingtian's PR rules and carries immediate dismissal.

scenes.title: Xie Ling Plots to Kill Charming Voyage
scenes.summary: Enraged by Xingtian's defiant culture and loyalty to Chun Yuqiao, Xie Ling tells his deputy that the only way to crush his rivals' momentum is to terminate the delayed travel show once and for all.

scenes.title: Extracting Secrets Over Cocktails
scenes.summary: Joining Xie Ling's deputy for drinks at a riverside bar, Bu Xiaogu learns Xie Ling is bypassing Director Deng to have DTS cancel the travel show and discovers the deputy expensed a gift bracelet to a project invoice.

scenes.title: Catching Xie Ling's Expense-Account Habit
scenes.summary: Summoning Kaiwen and Xingzi urgently, Bu Xiaogu shows them the bracelet billed to a project invoice—confirming Xie Ling's old financial habits from ME—while urging patience until the right moment.

scenes.title: Calling In a Favor to Save Charming Voyage
scenes.summary: To stop Xie Ling from persuading DTS executives to cancel the travel show, Bu Xiaogu calls in grateful actor Rong Silun's promised favor and plans with Xingzi and Kaiwen to find their own ally inside DTS.

scenes.title: Closing Theme Song
scenes.summary: Closing theme music and end credits conclude Episode 19.
